entries.wording: 【…】已将订单导入系统中，等待物流公司揽件
entries.english: The order is in the system at …, waiting for the pickup
entries.note: The first row, at the central warehouse in Australia. It goes on to ask for the recipient's ID card, which is taken out.

entries.english: Picked up at …, waiting for the details to be checked
entries.note: HP Express has the parcel in Australia.

entries.wording: 【…】包裹已通过信息审核，等待过机查验
entries.english: Details checked at …, waiting for the X-ray check
entries.note: At the transit warehouse before export.
At the transit warehouse before export.
Leaves the transit warehouse for the flight to China.

entries.wording: 【…】您的包裹已上飞机，飞往中国（厦门机场）
entries.english: On the plane from …, flying to China (Xiamen airport)
entries.note: The last row of the international leg.

entries.wording: 【…】您的包裹到达中国厦门机场
entries.english: Arrived at Xiamen airport in China
entries.note: The first row of the clearance leg.

entries.wording: 【…】您的包裹正在送往泉州口岸
entries.english: On its way to the Quanzhou port of entry
entries.note: Trucked from Xiamen airport to customs at Quanzhou.

entries.wording: 【…】您的包裹到达泉州口岸，正在清关中
entries.english: Arrived at the Quanzhou port of entry, clearing customs

entries.wording: 【…】您的包裹已通过海关检验，已放行，转入泉州邮政快递，包裹单号为：…
entries.english: Cleared and released by customs, handed to China Post in Quanzhou under number …
entries.note: The hand-off to China Post, with its domestic number.
China Post takes the parcel in at its cross-border office in Jinjiang after customs; HP Express accepted it in Australia.
China Post's scan through a transfer centre.
China Post's scan at a transfer centre.
The row goes on to name the postman and phones, which are taken out.
The row goes on to name where it was left, the postman and his phone, which are taken out.
